query:
SELECT 
  CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern'))) as lhp_length,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 800) as lhp_start
FROM analysis_reports WHERE clientId = 870001 LIMIT 1;
